PCI.BIO: Born in the Rio Grande Valley but reared in Fort Worth TX where I spent all of my public school years. Graduated the university with an MS in Computer Science and a M.Ed. in School Administration. Taught public high mathematics for eleven years, taught computer science at TSC thirty years and at UTB for twenty-two years. Also earned a certified network engineering certificate from Novell and an Enrolled Agent certificate from the Internal Revenue Service which declares that the Internal Revenue Service recognizes me as a TAX EXPERT.  Have lived in the valley for forty-four years.

SCHTEACH.PEDINN: I am teaching this course completely online and using live televising.  All of my labs and exams are given online so I have had to devise methods to use to present the material and also maintain secure standards.  I use Collaborative and Panopto to prepare lectures and short lesson on video.  This is all new and different from regular classroom lectures.  I also prepared an entire 16 week course during Blueprinting Sessions in the summer and I was in Summer Cohort 1D.  I used the course as the main course to present knowing that I would use it in the fall 2020.

SCHTEACH.PEDINN: This course is normally a lecture course that discusses the theory in networking and does not have any actual network development.  I am a certified Novell network engineer so I introduced network building and development into the course.
SCHTEACH.TECHMAT: To have the students build networks and in an economical manner, I used virtual machines software (VMware and Oracle VMBox) and other software ( Microsoft server 2012 R2 and Windows 10) that was free.  All the networks were built in one computer.
SCHTEACH.ENHSTUD: The students will be asked to bring laptop computers to class to have lab activities and lecture at least once each week.

SCHTEACH.TITLE: Database Design & Implement
SCHTEACH.PEDINN: Students are given several lab assignments to build and manipulate databases using SQL language.  We cover the entire Oracle 11g SQL textbook.  This is in addition to the required lectures , projects and exams on the theory of database design.  I want students to actually do hand-on database design and manipulation so they can have better employment opportunities.  I have had students obtain employment in database manipulation after this course.
